_readme: 12 simulated banking-support conversations, arriving as a 'live stream'. Each has turn-by-turn customer messages (already labelled with a sentiment_hint for you to key your lexicon off, plus a hidden 'true_sentiment_trend' you can use to check your own scorer), a resolved flag, and — where relevant — an escalated flag with an escalation_reason. Build your online QA pipeline against this file.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I see a charge on my card I don't recognize, this is worrying.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand the concern — let's get this sorted. Can you confirm the last 4 digits of the card?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, 4471.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks, I've filed a dispute for the charge and issued a temporary credit.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh great, thank you so much, that's a relief.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: What's my current balance?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Your current available balance is $2,340.12.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Perfect, thanks.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I got a fraud alert text, I'm really scared, is my money safe?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I hear you, let's check right now. Your account shows no unauthorized transactions in the last 24 hours.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Are you sure? I'm still nervous about this.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand. As an extra precaution I've frozen the card and I'm connecting you with our fraud specialist team now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: There's a charge I don't recognize again, this is the second time this month!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Let me look into it.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: This is so frustrating, your app keeps failing me.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand the frustration. I'm unable to process a second dispute this month automatically — let me connect you with a specialist.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: What are your current personal loan rates?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Our current personal loan rates start at 10.5% APR depending on credit profile.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Great, thank you, that's helpful.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I need to activate my new debit card.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Happy to help! Can you confirm your date of birth for verification?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: March 14th.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, your card is now active.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Awesome, appreciate the quick help!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I want to close my account, I'm switching banks.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to see you go. Account closures need a branch visit or a signed form — I can email that form to you now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Fine, I guess, send it over.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Why was I charged an overdraft fee, this is ridiculous, I've been a customer for 10 years!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand the frustration — let me check your account history.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: This better be resolved, I'm this close to leaving the bank.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I've reversed the $35 overdraft fee as a one-time courtesy.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, thank you, I appreciate that.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I need to send $5,000 to an account overseas urgently.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can help set that up. International transfers above $2,000 require additional verification through a specialist for security reasons.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That's really inconvenient, I needed this done today.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand the urgency — I've flagged this as priority and connected you with our transfers team.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Can you show me my last 5 transactions?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Here are your last 5 transactions: [list omitted]. Anything else?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No that's all, thanks.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Another unauthorized charge?! Nobody is helping me here, I've called three times this week!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm very sorry about the repeated issue. Let me look at the full history.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I don't want to repeat myself again, just fix it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Understood — I can see the prior two disputes are still open. I'm escalating this as a priority case to a senior specialist who will call you within the hour.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: What's the interest rate on my savings account?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Your savings account currently earns 3.2% APY.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Perfect, thank you!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thanks for the quick reply, I'd love a credit limit increase please.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me check your eligibility now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Great, appreciate it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry, based on your current profile you're not eligible for an increase at this time.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That's unacceptable, this is ridiculous, I've never missed a payment!
